summary: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central overview video (2023-10-24, 3 min) aimed at small and medium businesses. It covers the cloud suite for finance, sales and operations, AI and Copilot, Microsoft 365 and Power Platform integration, inventory management, and Azure infrastructure. It is a high-level introduction.
overview:
The video is a short introduction to Dynamics 365 Business Central for small and medium businesses that want to grow and become more efficient by adopting new tools and processes. It presents Business Central as an all-in-one cloud suite for finance, service, sales and operations, available in over 130 countries and built on Azure.

It then covers AI features for repetitive tasks, Copilot, Microsoft 365 and Power Platform integration, and automated workflows. A customer example describes better inventory level management with Business Central, leading to best-selling months. The video closes on real-time cash flow insights and key performance metrics.
key_points: Business Central is described as an all-in-one suite for small and medium businesses covering finance, service, sales and operations.
It is stated to be available in over 130 countries.
It is built on Azure, with the reliability, security and compliance that comes with it.
Integration with Microsoft 365 is described, including business intelligence through the Power Platform to visualize data in new ways.
AI features and Copilot are presented as ways to reduce repetitive daily tasks and raise productivity.
A customer example says managing inventory levels with Business Central made every month their best selling month.
Real-time insights into cash flow and key performance metrics are described as available at any time and location.
